format: SGB TEA, one graph per line; vertex labels 1 through 100

cfs_definitions.legacy_cfs: Original executable: a square-graph component supports every original vertex.
cfs_definitions.intended_cfs: A square-graph component supports every nonuniversal vertex; a complete join factor is allowed. Universal vertices are never added to literal square support. Complete-only and empty-graph base cases are unestablished and are not benchmarked.

expectation_derivation: An m-pair path has 5m-9 squares; a pair ring (m>=5) has 5m. Bridges and pendant edges introduce no cycles.
random_generator: Python random.Random(seed).random(), lexicographic pairs i<j; the same seeds across densities give nested edge sets, not independent samples.
